# Tony Tsang (TSANG Cheuk Nam)

> Final-year HKUST Industrial Engineering & Engineering Management + AI student, Hong Kong. Winner, "Reinventing Insurance for an AI-native World" track (sponsored by bolttech), Hong Kong AI Summit: BUILD ACROSS Hackathon, October 2026, among 200+ participants, with his own methodology; he then built the complete system, directing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex). Available for internships now and full-time from January 2027. Contact: cheuknam2004@gmail.com.

## Case studies

- [Budget-Based Microinsurance](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/microinsurance/): an AI-native redesign of insurance where customers choose the price and AI builds the cover; won its hackathon track among 200+ participants.
- [LLM Brand Recommendation Benchmark](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/brand-benchmark/): an AI-run pipeline he designed to measure which brands AI assistants recommend, with every answer checked against verified brand lists.
- [Using LLMs for Optimization](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/llm-optimization/): Final Year Project as Experiment & Benchmarking Lead; showed an LLM works best when it plans and a proven optimizer solves.
- [Polymarket Market-Making & Forecasting Models](https://rairurairu.github.io/work/polymarket-models/): AI-agent-driven quantitative research; forecasting models that beat the standard Elo rating.
